scenes.sub: In four short verses, Surah Al-Ikhlas teaches that Allah is One, and nothing is like Him.
scenes.translation: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge. He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

scenes.sub: We teach every child slowly, letter by letter, until it sounds right.
Classes cover Noorani Qaida, Quran reading, tajweed and hifz.
Every class is live and one to one, with a tested teacher.
Book a free trial class at nurulhudaacademy.org
